scope: Only the ten readable-v1 items left after the six approved replacements: two swords, four metal materials, two quench liquids and two dried foods. Preserve the approved six, all other images, gameplay and layout.
designIntent: Continue the refined classical cultivation painting approved in refined-study-v2, while keeping material tier and processing stage readable through broad structure rather than hue or fine surface details alone.

referenceRoles: User-approved illustration style and iron/dark-steel family anchor. Use the existing rough iron sword, finished dark-steel sword and ingots to guide their new neighbours; do not regenerate the six pictured objects.

items.name: 铁剑
items.signature: Long slender silver diamond-ridge blade and visibly arched classical guard; more regular and deliberate than the approved rough iron sword, not as broad or dark as dark-steel swords.

items.name: 粗炼乌钢剑
items.signature: Broad heavy dark leaf-shaped blade and compact plain block guard; unlike the slender iron family or the finished dark-steel sword with a shaped twin-wing guard.

items.name: 碎铁料
items.signature: Several bent narrow tool strips and an open hook; unmistakably scrap rather than a solid casting or refined slab.

items.name: 乌钢碎料
items.signature: Broad dark curved armor fragments in a compact fanned stack; thick plate silhouette, not a recolor of narrow iron strips.

items.name: 百炼铁料
items.signature: Thin flat bright rectangular forged slab with a broad uninterrupted face and narrow edge; no tip, hilt or thick ingot profile.

items.name: 乌钢精料
items.signature: Short thick hexagonal blue-black forged billet with a large faceted end face; clearly different from a thin slab or trapezoidal ingot.

referenceRoles: User-approved refined painting, soft layered volume, coherent light and classical cultivation design. Apply to liquids and dried foods without copying the pictured swords, clothing or metal objects.

items.name: 粗制淬液
items.signature: Squat wide open clay crock with cloudy opaque liquid and simple lip; ordinary material, carefully painted.

items.name: 桦脂淬液
items.signature: Tall slender-neck classical glass vessel with clear amber resin liquid, cloth stopper and simple cord tie; not a modern laboratory flask.

items.name: 肉干
items.signature: Several long narrow uneven dried strips gathered with a simple hemp tie; preserved food, not raw meat.

items.name: 精肉脯
items.signature: Broad dense rectangular dried slices arranged as a flat stepped fan, clean edges and softly layered deep red-brown meat; not another bundle of thin strips.
